reviews.notes: Four thin pale streams leave the fish-mouth outlets, curve gently inward, and land well inside the basin rim.
Every stream terminates in two concentric surface ripples and a short splash stem visible in both browser and Blender review renders.
Sixteen narrow radial joints sit on the visible top of the rounded basin rim and align with a sixteen-segment lower wall.
The base now has explicit ledges plus flush radial top joints and full-height riser joints instead of isolated floating markers.
Subtle rim and body joints separate the upper stone bowl into readable constructed sections.
